sentences.text: Thus, the total compensation to which claimants are entitled to is Rs.18,72,200-.
The Tribunal has already awarded Rs.16,47,400/-, therefore, enhancement of compensation would be Rs.2,24,800/-.
10. It is observed that in the pre-sitting, if the docket had been signed then company would have be benefited by Rs.20,000/- but that was not done.
Therefore, there is loss to the company on principal amount as well as interest.
11. Since Court fee of Rs.5000/- has been paid only for Rs.2,00,000/-, therefore, the compensation is enhanced by Rs.2,00,000/- only.
The other terms and conditions of the Tribunal including rate of interest are kept intact.
12. With aforesaid enhancement in compensation amount of Rs.2,000,00/- the appeal is allowed.
13. If the Managing Director of the IFCO TOKIO General Insurance Company inclined, may recover the balance amount from the concerned officer who caused lost to the company.
Let copy of this order be sent to the Managing Director, IFCO TOKIO General Insurance Company.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE mc Suhadra Bai Chandrapuriya vs Rajesh Kumar Sahu on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30185551/
